scripts.build: pnpm run clean && esbuild src/local.ts src/lambda.ts src/reconciliation/lambda.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outdir=dist --entry-names='[dir]/[name]' --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
